bottom_line: No source checked here is verified to list every house in Montana. The closest statewide list is the MSL Structures and Addresses Framework: 674,715 points, 493,975 coded as residences, against 514,803 housing units in the 2020 census (state ratio 0.96). County ratios run from 0.48 to 1.36, and a live count reproduces them. The MSL parcel file covers 'most of Montana' (920,986 records; situs filled on 56.5%). Microsoft footprints give 773,199 Montana buildings with no address fields. No Montana-only NAD count was obtained (state filters fail; a bounding box gives 662,158, including parts of Idaho and Wyoming). OpenAddresses lists two Montana sources, both on MSL files or a City of Helena service.

limits: Downloads: 264,186,159 bytes logged across 213 requests (cap 300,000,000 B). The address-point member was streamed twice (once for counts, once for the parcel join), which accounts for about 53 MB.

Not downloaded, sizes only: MontanaCadastral_SHP.zip 1,040,691,781 B; MontanaCadastral_GDB.zip 867,382,653 B; MTParcels_GDB.zip 249,250,816 B; Yellowstone_SHP.zip 251,509,408 B; Yellowstone_GDB.zip 45,236,288 B; StructuresFramework_gdb.zip 61,058,458 B (central directory only); StatewideCama.zip 80,238,862 B (central directory only); NAD TXT.zip 8,477,543,836 B (central directory only); ORION COUNTY*.ZIP and STATE-WIDE.ZIP (1,695,497,876 B); the 13 archived framework zips.
Not decoded: ESRI file geodatabase tables (StatewideCama, StructuresFramework GDB), Microsoft SQL Server ORION databases, and the NAD Deflate64 text member (no Deflate64 decoder used).
Owner names and owner mailing fields were never read into the output. Parcel values were used only as counts (blank or non-blank, grouped by county).
No source checked is verified to list every house in Montana. The MSL address points and the parcel file are federated and uneven; counties differ in load date and completeness.
The 2020 census housing-unit column was first found by a value rule; the refuter confirmed the H1_001N to H1_003N labels through the API. The PL layout document was not read.

Montana NAD count not obtained: State, County and Zip_Code filters return error 400 after about 55 s; the envelope (inSR 4326) gives 662,158 including Idaho and Wyoming; polygon queries failed or returned 0. NAD text not streamed.
OpenAddresses Montana sources were listed by the refuter from a sparse git read; the GitHub API path still returns 403.
USDOT transportation.gov pages returned HTTP 403 'Access Denied' from this environment (four URLs); the NAD disclaimer and download pages were not read.

County portals: one web search returned only commercial reseller pages and no county-owned page. No county portal was opened, so county terms are unverified. The five counties that maintain their own parcels (Ravalli, Silver Bow, Missoula, Flathead, Yellowstone) are named in the MSL metadata only.
The census API terms were read; the terms of the static census files were not. Census API requests need a key (not requested).
Live counts differ from the files: structures service 674,469 vs file 674,715; parcel service 921,301 vs file 920,986. Query time about 20:40 UTC on 2026-10-17.
Duplicate and blank checks: 673,332 unique NGUID values of 674,715 points (1,383 duplicates); 33,491 parcel records have a blank PARCELID.
Microsoft footprints: 88.3% of features have a blank capture_dates_range, so their vintage is unknown for most of the state.
Residence coding uses Place_Type only; it is not a dwelling count and it is not checked against a field survey. Ratios to housing units are indicators, not coverage proofs.
Coordinates in the address points come only from the shapefile geometry (NAD83(2011) / Montana, metres); the Latitude and Longitude columns are zero.
The 'live' service counts were read once; they are not a verified time series.
open_questions: Load records exist for Glacier, Roosevelt and Big Horn, plus separate Blackfeet and Northern Cheyenne loads. What explains the low ratios: coverage inside each load, vacant or seasonal housing, or Fort Peck (no separate load found by name)?

What is the Montana-only NAD count? State, County and Zip_Code filters fail and polygon queries failed; the Montana box gives 662,158 (includes Idaho and Wyoming). Needs a working filter or a Deflate64 reader for the 8.48 GB national text file.
Do the 1,383 duplicate NGUID values and the 2.9% unmatched ParcelIDs (19,144 points) need a dedupe rule before any join?
Does the ORION Res table (residential improvements per parcel) give a dwelling count per parcel? It needs an SQL Server or file geodatabase reader; the tables are not decoded.

Commercial use and redistribution: the MSL metadata gives no licence grant. The quoted MCA 2-6-109 and 2-6-1017 text restricts mailing lists. Counsel or the MSL must state whether owner-bearing parcel data may be published or used commercially.
Terms for the five county-maintained parcel sets (Ravalli, Silver Bow, Missoula, Flathead, Yellowstone) are not read.
OpenAddresses Montana sources are listed (statewide.json, helena.json) with no licence key. The statewide source is built on MSL files, so MSL terms are the likely constraint; not checked.
Terms for the static census files were not read (only the API terms).
Is the MSL parcel file (MTParcels) the same data as the county files? Counts were not reconciled county by county (the statewide total is 920,986; the live layer shows 921,301).
Does the statewide address file carry the structure points the hail product needs (MT_PlcType codes for dwellings: 101, 102, 106, 107), and how are multi-unit parcels counted?
Which 'every house' source should W9 treat as the base table: the structures framework points (674,715), the parcels (920,986), or a census-controlled blend?

programs.name: Montana Cadastral Framework (MSL parcels)
programs.what_it_gives: Statewide tax parcels (920,986 records; 'most of Montana'), PARCELID, county, situs address lines, legal description, acreage, values and owner name and mailing fields (names not recorded here). Per-county zips and a statewide zip.
programs.cost_or_licence: No fee shown on the download pages. Use constraints quoted in terms (MCA 2-6-109 and 2-6-1017 mailing-list limits; disclaimer). No licence grant found.

programs.name: Montana Structures and Addresses Framework (MSL)
programs.what_it_gives: 674,715 structure and address points statewide (street fields, Post_Code, Place_Type, MT_PlcType, ParcelID); county loads from 2016 to 2026; NENA NG9-1-1 GIS Data Model (metadata).
programs.cost_or_licence: No fee stated on the MSL page. Access constraint: 'None. All data contained in the Framework are publicly available and non-sensitive.' Use constraint: 'for no other purpose'. No licence grant found.
